Acolyte

Please help support the mission of New Advent and get the full contents of this website as an instant download.

The acolyte holds the minor order in the Roman Church immediately below the subdiaconate, and above that of exorcist.

The duties of the acolyte are to light and carry the candles at the Gospel and at the offertory of the Mass.
